'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Alex O'Shea LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Alex O'Shea]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name RIP Communing. Alex O'Shea / Thursday, 2014 Worlds Day 2 8/23/14, 2013 form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Communing (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-communing-pre.gif|label=Communing}}
* '''Username:''' Thursday
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
